Theoretically, under the squared $\ell_2$ parameter estimation error, we establish upper bounds of $\widetilde{O}(s^*/n + {s^*}^2/n^2\varepsilon^2)$ for $(\varepsilon,δ)$-Sample-DP and $\widetilde{O}(s^*/n + s^*/n\varepsilon^2)$ for $\varepsilon$-Label-DP based on randomized response, where $n$ is the training data size. For the lower bounds, we show that the Sample-DP rate is nearly optimal, and that the guarantee for our Label-DP method cannot be further improved within the randomized-response framework. We also provide a general lower bound for the problem with Label-DP. Empirically, our framework demonstrates superior efficacy over dense baselines across sentiment generation and safety alignment benchmarks, offering a significantly more favorable privacy-utility trade-off.
arxiv.titleZh: 基于偏好反馈的差分隐私稀疏奖励估计
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有隐私对齐方法假设奖励模型为稠密参数化，估计误差随模型维度d呈多项式增长，在过参数化模型下难以承受。该工作提出Private Sparse RLHF：假设人类偏好仅由s*≪d个相关特征决定，在Bradley-Terry-Luce模型下建立首个从成对偏好反馈做差分隐私稀疏奖励估计的理论框架，并为Sample-DP与Label-DP（随机化响应）两种设定设计高效算法。参数ℓ2误差上界分别为Õ(s*/n+s*²/(n²ε²))与Õ(s*/n+s*/(nε²))，且证明Sample-DP速率近最优、Label-DP在随机化响应框架内不可改进。情感生成与安全对齐实验中，相较稠密基线取得更优的隐私—效用权衡。
arxiv.reason: RLHF隐私对齐的理论工作，稀疏奖励估计，扎实命中后训练方向

arxiv.title: Orbitol: Crystal Generation on Wyckoff Orbits
arxiv.abstract: Generative models propose crystalline materials by learning composition and geometry, but unconditional sampling gives no direct control over the space group, which constrains whether responses such as piezoelectricity are symmetry-allowed. We present Orbitol, a crystal generator built on the Crystalite diffusion Transformer that replaces atom tokens with Wyckoff-orbit tokens. Given a space group and a collection of occupied Wyckoff positions, Orbitol generates the atom type and free coordinates of each orbit together with a compatible lattice, so every valid structure is invariant under the operations of the requested group. It generates structures two to three orders of magnitude faster than the symmetry-aware baselines at the evaluated settings. On MP-20, 13.8% of Orbitol's attempts yielded stable or metastable, unique and novel structures that retained the requested space group after relaxation, compared with 10.8% for SGFM, the next best model. We also introduce SPARC, a score that combines retention of the raw detected space group with agreement between the retained-group and training distributions. Finally, we used Orbitol to generate candidates in piezoelectric crystal classes. Of the structures selected by internal screening, 89% passed our density functional theory checks, and 79% also matched no Materials Project or Alexandria entry with the same space group. Their median figure of merit was nine times that of the piezoelectric materials computed in the Materials Project, and 24% of the new candidates ranked in that set's top 10%.
arxiv.titleZh: Orbitol：基于 Wyckoff 轨道的晶体生成
arxiv.summaryZh: 无条件晶体生成无法控制空间群，而空间群决定了压电性等性质是否对称允许。Orbitol 以 Crystalite 扩散 Transformer 为基础，用 Wyckoff 轨道 token 替换原子 token：给定空间群与占据的 Wyckoff 位置，联合生成每个轨道的原子类型、自由坐标及兼容晶格，使结构天然满足目标群对称性；在评测设置下比对称感知基线快两到三个数量级。在 MP-20 上，13.8% 的采样经弛豫后仍保持目标空间群，且为稳定或亚稳、唯一且新颖的结构，优于次优模型 SGFM 的 10.8%；同时提出 SPARC 评分衡量空间群保留与分布一致性。在压电晶类筛选中，89% 的候选通过 DFT 检查，79% 与 Materials Project 和 Alexandria 中同空间群条目均不重合。
arxiv.reason: 扩散模型用于晶体材料生成，落在低分方向

arxiv.title: Circuits of LLM Classifiers
arxiv.abstract: Language models make it easy to build classifiers by simply prompting a model with the sample to classify. However, their predictions are neither deterministic nor uniformly reliable across samples. How can we combine predictions from different models to improve reliability? We view LLM classifiers as noisy measurement instruments of an underlying target label. Our goal is to maximize average classification accuracy at a given average query cost. To this end, we introduce circuits that organize LLM classifiers into an adaptive sequence of queries and decisions. We then characterize the optimal circuit, obtain the fundamental limits of achievable accuracy, and provide practical insights on realizing the optimal circuit. Across seven classification tasks spanning safety, health, political science, human preference, agent evaluation, decision-making and reasoning, our method improves the cost-accuracy frontier over routing and cascading baselines.
arxiv.titleZh: LLM 分类器的电路
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对 LLM 分类器预测不确定、跨样本可靠性不一的问题，如何组合不同模型的预测以提升可靠性。把 LLM 分类器视为对潜在目标标签的含噪测量仪器，在给定平均查询成本下最大化平均分类准确率：引入 circuit 将分类器组织为自适应的查询—决策序列，刻画最优 circuit 并给出可达精度的基本极限与实际实现要点。在安全、健康、政治科学、人类偏好、Agent 评估、决策与推理等七项分类任务上，该方法在成本—准确率前沿优于 routing 与 cascading 基线。
arxiv.reason: LLM 组合与自适应查询的成本—准确率方法，擦边效率与评估方向

arxiv.title: From Classifier Heads to Encoder Prototypes: Personalized Federated Learning with Head-Derived Clustering
arxiv.abstract: Personalized federated learning must decide which clients should share representations. We introduce HDC-FL (Head-Derived Clustering for Personalized Federated Learning), which reads that decision off a signal shared-encoder training already produces: the client-specific classifi- er heads. At periodic refresh rounds the server projects the cached heads into a normalized low-rank descriptor space, groups the descriptors, builds one encoder prototype per group from the cached client encoders, and returns to each client a soft mixture of those prototypes paired with its own unchanged head. Client-specific heads are never averaged or distributed to oth- er clients; the shared-encoder trajectory is left intact; and no second optimization trajectory, additional local objective, or post-training fine-tuning stage is required. Across 11 CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 configurations covering label-subset, Dirichlet and rotation heterogeneity with ResNet-18 and MobileNetV2 encoders, HDC-FL is competitive with the strongest personalized and clustered baselines in macro-averaged mean accuracy and attains the numerically highest macro-averaged worst-client and bottom-20% accuracy among the evaluated methods. The tail results distinguish methods that look similar when only their means are compared. A controlled donor-swap diagnostic further finds positive donor-ranking associations between head similarity and encoder compatibility in all three settings tested, most clearly under covariate shift.
arxiv.titleZh: 从分类器头到编码器原型：基于头导出聚类的个性化联邦学习
arxiv.summaryZh: 个性化联邦学习需要判断哪些客户端应共享表征。HDC-FL 以共享编码器训练中已产生的客户端分类头作为这一判断的信号：服务器在周期性刷新轮将缓存的头投影到归一化低秩描述子空间并聚类，按组用缓存的客户端编码器构建编码器原型，再向每个客户端返回这些原型的软混合，而该客户端自身的分类头保持不变；分类头从不在客户端间被平均或分发，共享编码器的训练轨迹不受扰动，也无需引入第二条优化轨迹或后训练微调。在覆盖标签子集、Dirichlet 与旋转异构、ResNet-18 与 MobileNetV2 的 11 组 CIFAR-10/100 配置上，宏平均准确率与最强个性化及聚类基线相当，worst-client 与 bottom-20% 宏平均准确率为参评方法中最高。替换供体的诊断实验中，头相似度与编码器兼容性呈正相关，协变量偏移下最明显。
arxiv.reason: 个性化联邦学习聚类，与 LLM 后训练/Agent 方向无交集

arxiv.title: Parallel AI Agent Collaboration as Graph-Structured Distributed Block Optimization
arxiv.abstract: Parallel AI agents can produce useful local edits yet degrade a shared solution when their edits are combined. We model this coordination problem as discrete block optimization with an exactly evaluable objective and a known dependency graph. Independent sets certify compatible edits whose verified gains, measured against the same current solution, add exactly. A coordinator constructs a safe compatible candidate and can also evaluate interacting edits to capture favorable interactions. We prove that an optimal fractional coloring yields a merger that preserves a $1/χ_f(G)$ fraction of the total verified local improvement, where $χ_f(G)$ is the graph's fractional chromatic number. This guarantee is tight among mergers that select a subset of the same proposals. Under conditional local-improvement guarantees and a block error-bound condition, repeated collaboration converges geometrically in the objective gap. The rate separates task structure, agent allocation, and computation cost, yielding a linear program for agent assignment and an explicit time-cost trade-off. Code-repair experiments show that verified merging resolves conflicts between individually useful edits that cause naive merging to fail. On larger conflict-free tasks, parallel agents reduce modeled completion time at higher input-token-equivalent cost. On three public road networks, fractional integration retains 922 units of verified graph-cut improvement across 90 paired runs. For route-search agents sharing exclusive access to vehicle routes, fractional scheduling reduces measured wall time by a median of 15% across twelve paired runs, with route-cost changes varying across runs.
arxiv.titleZh: 并行AI Agent协作作为图结构分布式块优化
arxiv.summaryZh: 并行AI Agent的局部编辑在合并时可能破坏共享解。该工作将协调问题建模为依赖图上的离散块优化，用独立集认证可兼容编辑，并由协调器构造安全候选、评估交互编辑;证明最优分数着色合并可保留至少1/χ_f(G)的已验证局部增益且该界紧，在条件下重复协作以几何速率收敛，并给出Agent分配的线性规划与时间—成本权衡。代码修复实验显示验证合并能化解使朴素合并失败的编辑冲突;较大无冲突任务上并行降低建模完成时间但提高token等价成本，三个路网上分数整合在90次配对运行中保留922单位图割改进，路线搜索中位墙钟时间降低15%。
arxiv.reason: 多智能体协作与冲突合并，贴合Agent方向，偏理论优化

arxiv.title: Charts as Epistemic Actions for Experience-Driven Agentic Data Analysis
arxiv.abstract: Data agents built on ReAct-style loops now execute complex analytical workflows over structured data, yet their intermediate reasoning still runs almost entirely through text. Human analysts instead move between numbers, tables, and charts, reading visual evidence to expose trends and anomalies that text summaries drop. We ask whether charts can serve as internal epistemic actions inside a data agent's reasoning loop, and how to teach an agent to use them. We first build \probe{}, a suite of 200 controlled tasks under four matched interface conditions, and find a persistent gap between what agents can read and what they choose to use. Agents score as well from self-generated charts as from numeric output, yet plotting access alone does not translate into consistent use. Task slices show that charts lead on temporal, pattern, and anomaly reasoning, while text leads on precise reading and conditional verification. We then propose \method{}, which distils two families of experience from conditioned trajectory rollouts. One family records how to select and verify analytical operations, and the other records when to invoke text, charts, or both. A trajectory judge scores outcomes and labels intermediate steps, and a validation gate admits only experience that improves held-out performance. On three held-out benchmarks with four LLM backbones, \method{} raises analytical accuracy and visual evidence quality over matched baselines, and backbones that never drew charts begin using them, all without touching model parameters.
arxiv.titleZh: 作为认知行动的图表：面向经验驱动的 Agent 数据分析
arxiv.summaryZh: 数据 Agent 的中间推理几乎全走文本，而人类分析师会在数字、表格与图表间切换。工作构建 probe：200 个受控任务、四种匹配接口条件，发现读图能力与自发用图之间存在稳定落差——自生成图表的答题效果与数值输出相当，但开放绘图权限并不带来一致使用；图表在时序、模式与异常推理上占优，文本在精确读数与验证上占优。随后提出方法，从条件化轨迹 rollout 中蒸馏两类经验：如何选择与验证分析操作，以及何时调用文本、图表或两者；轨迹评判器标注中间步骤并打分，验证门只接纳在留出集上有提升的经验。在三个基准、四个骨干上，分析准确率与视觉证据质量优于匹配基线，未画过图的骨干开始用图，且不更新参数。
arxiv.reason: Agent 经验蒸馏与工具使用机制，直接命中 Agent 与后训练方向

arxiv.title: Loopholing All the Way: Language Modeling with pure Self-Conditioning
arxiv.abstract: Recent Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) use Self-Conditioning (SC), or Loopholing, to improve their performance. While SC is traditionally seen as an auxiliary heuristic, its empirical success raises the question: can a continuous generative model be based purely on Self-Conditioning? We answer affirmatively with LAW (``Loopholing All the Way''), which propagates the Expected Embedding under the denoiser's prediction across steps, decoding the tokens once, at the end. On Sudoku, LAW outperforms previous Discrete and Continuous Diffusion Models, including Loopholing Discrete Diffusion. On Maze, LAW is the most accurate from 2 to 64 NFE. After training on TinyGSM and sampling at temperature 1 with 1024 NFE, LAW solves 42.2% of GSM8K problems against 34.5% for uniform Loopholing Discrete Diffusion. Additionally, fine-tuning a pre-trained Uniform Diffusion Model (Duo) with LAW increases its accuracy from 17.2% to 48.1%. Finally, on OpenWebText, LAW pushes the Pareto frontier and approaches Autoregressive Models (ARMs) with 64 NFE. Find our code at https://github.com/ilievanadezhda/law.
arxiv.titleZh: 「Loopholing 到底」:纯自条件化的语言建模
arxiv.summaryZh: 扩散语言模型普遍把自条件化(Self-Conditioning，即 Loopholing)当作辅助启发式，其经验收益引出一个问题:连续生成模型能否完全建立在自条件化之上。LAW 在每一步传播去噪器预测下的期望嵌入，直到最后才一次性解码出 token，从而让生成过程完全由自条件化驱动。Sudoku 上 LAW 优于已有离散与连续扩散模型，包括 Loopholing 离散扩散;Maze 上在 2–64 NFE 区间内最准确;在 TinyGSM 上训练后，以温度 1、1024 NFE 采样，GSM8K 解出率为 42.2%，而均匀 Loopholing 离散扩散为 34.5%;用 LAW 微调预训练的统一扩散模型 Duo，可把准确率从 17.2% 提升到 48.1%;在 OpenWebText 上，LAW 推进了 Pareto 前沿，并在 64 NFE 时接近自回归模型。
arxiv.reason: 扩散语言模型按本画像属低分一类，仅推理评测略微沾边

arxiv.title: GoiBERT: Compact Vietnamese Language Models via Two-Stage Knowledge Distillation
arxiv.abstract: Vietnamese pre-trained encoders have improved rapidly, but the strongest ones are large, multilingual-vocabulary models or depend on external word segmentation, which makes them costly to deploy. We present GoiBERT, a family of two compact Vietnamese encoders with 26M and 49M parameters that operate directly on raw text. GoiBERT learns from two complementary teachers. A same-tokenizer Vietnamese encoder first teaches general-purpose representations. A much larger teacher then provides task-level guidance through soft labels that are generated without ever labeling its own training data. Across eight benchmarks covering text classification, aspect-based sentiment analysis, natural language inference, and named entity recognition, GoiBERT-large achieves the highest average score among non-teacher models. It does so with fewer than half the parameters of the strongest compact baseline and twice its throughput. GoiBERT-base retains 99% of that baseline's performance at a quarter of its size. Our analysis shows that compression is nearly lossless for sentiment and classification tasks but remains costly for inference and entity recognition, which points to clear directions for future work. Our code and models are available at: https://github.com/Nhantran65/GoiBERT.git
arxiv.titleZh: GoiBERT：通过两阶段知识蒸馏构建的紧凑越南语语言模型
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对越南语预训练编码器依赖大模型、多语种词表或外部分词，导致部署成本高的问题，构建了 26M 与 49M 两个直接处理原始文本的紧凑编码器。采用两阶段知识蒸馏：先由使用相同分词器的越南语编码器传授通用表示，再由更大的教师模型通过软标签提供任务级指导，且这些软标签无需标注教师模型自身的训练数据。在覆盖文本分类、方面级情感分析、自然语言推理与命名实体识别的八个基准上，GoiBERT-large 取得非教师模型的最高平均分，参数量不到最强紧凑基线的一半，吞吐量却是其两倍；GoiBERT-base 以四分之一的规模保留该基线 99% 的性能。分析显示，压缩对情感与分类任务近乎无损，对推理与实体识别任务仍有明显损失。
arxiv.reason: 编码器蒸馏，不属 LLM 主线，方法增量且局限于越南语

arxiv.title: Looped Uniform Diffusion Language Models
arxiv.abstract: Uniform diffusion language models (UDLMs) generate text by iteratively denoising sequences of ordinary vocabulary tokens, any of which may be corrupted and subsequently revised. During training, UDLMs must denoise from a context that may itself be unreliable, whereas masked diffusion language models (MDLMs) always condition on a clean context. This challenging training objective makes UDLMs more FLOP-intensive to train than MDLMs, but it yields stronger downstream reasoning performance. Recently, selective looping, which recursively applies a few early Transformer layers within each denoising step, has been shown to improve training efficiency in MDLMs under an iso-FLOP budget. We investigate looping in UDLMs while keeping the training objective and sampler unchanged. We find that looping significantly improves training efficiency: looped UDLMs reach the validation NLL of a non-looped UDLM trained on about 0.5 trillion tokens with up to 2.8x fewer training FLOPs on OpenWebText and 3.3x fewer on FineWeb-Edu. We also find that, at a matched NFE budget, looped UDLMs reach up to 9.8% lower generation perplexity than the non-looped UDLM, with most gains achieved at moderate loop counts. Finally, we study different loop-count distributions and find that sampling smaller loop counts more frequently during training improves inference efficiency: on downstream tasks, this strategy uses 12% fewer loops than uniform loop-count sampling without degrading accuracy.
arxiv.titleZh: 循环均匀扩散语言模型
arxiv.summaryZh: 均匀扩散语言模型（UDLM）需在自身可能含噪的上下文上做去噪，训练开销高于掩码扩散模型（MDLM），但下游推理表现更强。该工作在训练目标与采样器不变的前提下，将选择性循环（在每个去噪步内递归复用少数底层 Transformer 层）引入 UDLM。结果显示：循环版 UDLM 在 OpenWebText 上以最多 2.8 倍、FineWeb-Edu 上以最多 3.3 倍的训练 FLOPs 节省，达到非循环 UDLM 约 0.5 万亿 token 训练的验证 NLL；在相同 NFE 预算下生成困惑度最多低 9.8%，增益主要来自中等循环次数。作者还比较了循环次数分布，训练时更频繁采样较小循环次数可使下游任务循环用量减少 12% 且不损精度。
arxiv.reason: 扩散语言模型训练效率改进，属画像明确排除的扩散方向

arxiv.title: SWE-DIVE: Multi-Turn Coding Agent Evaluation with Dynamic User Simulation
arxiv.abstract: Coding agents are typically evaluated using one-shot, well-formulated prompts. Benchmarks such as SWE-bench use existing GitHub issues as input for a coding agent and evaluate whether the agent successfully solves the task. However, in real-world use cases, prompts are often not as well-formulated or structured as existing GitHub issues. Additionally, a coding agent session is not limited to a single prompt; it typically involves a multi-turn interaction in which the user iteratively adds new tasks and requirements that the agent must fulfill. To benchmark these abilities, we developed SWE-DIVE, a dynamic, interactive validation and evaluation framework for benchmarking coding agents in a multi-turn environment. To achieve this, we introduce a user simulator that can simulate different behavioral patterns and communicate with the coding agent. We also introduce a conversation validator that evaluates the user simulator's outputs to determine whether they fulfill the initial requirements and guide the agent toward successfully solving the task. The entire framework is embedded in a Harbor environment, which orchestrates the coding agent, user simulator, and conversation validator, and executes the test environment to determine whether the agent successfully solves the task. Our results and source code are available in our GitHub repository (https://github.com/lorenzbrehme/swe-dive_usersim).
arxiv.comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 workshop "Grounded User Simulation for Model Evaluation and Training: Diversity, Fidelity, and Validity'' (non-archival)
arxiv.titleZh: SWE-DIVE：基于动态用户模拟的多轮编程智能体评测
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有 SWE-bench 类基准以单轮、表述良好的 GitHub issue 作为输入，与真实使用中需求模糊、多轮追加要求的交互形态不符。SWE-DIVE 构建动态交互式评测框架：用可模拟多种行为模式的用户模拟器与编程智能体对话，再由对话校验器判断模拟器输出是否满足初始需求并把智能体引向正确解法，整体运行在 Harbor 环境中编排智能体、模拟器与校验器并执行测试环境判定任务成败。该工作面向多轮编程智能体的评测方法学，适用于检验 Agent 在需求不清、迭代追加场景下的鲁棒性。
arxiv.reason: 多轮编程智能体评测加用户模拟，命中 Agent 与评测方向，但属 workshop 基准

arxiv.title: Which Differences Matter? Controlled Tests of Rule Transfer, Joint Reliability, and Information Use in Decision Models
arxiv.abstract: Decision models map stated rules and observed states to discrete answers. Aggregate accuracy leaves unresolved which rule and information changes guide those answers. We connect controlled input changes to transfer, joint reliability, and directed information use through executable arithmetic rules. Semantic rule separation and crossed rule and state tests make transfer and joint success separately measurable. We compare equivalent wordings, calibrate joint correctness through marginal-preserving reassociation, and alter tables to define alternative answer targets. Adaptation gains increase with nearest-source answer agreement; fully conflicting quartets yield small pooled gains and different gain signs across source splits. Equivalent rewrites have opposing task-level effects, linking transfer gains to rule presentation. Joint-score departures depend on which rule and state associations the reference preserves. A decision service changes answers more across equivalent wordings than across identical-text repeats and usually follows the answer targets implied by altered table values or mappings.
arxiv.titleZh: 哪些差异才重要？决策模型中规则迁移、联合可靠性与信息利用的受控测试
arxiv.summaryZh: 聚合准确率无法说明模型究竟依据哪条规则、哪些输入信息给出离散答案。该工作用可执行的算术规则构造受控输入变化：通过语义规则分离以及「规则×状态」交叉测试，分别度量规则迁移与联合正确性；借助保持边际分布的重关联校准联合得分，并通过改写表格数值或映射来定义替代答案目标。结果显示，适配增益随与最近源答案的一致程度上升；完全冲突的四元组上合并增益很小，且增益符号随源划分翻转；等价改写会产生相反的任务级效应；决策服务在等价措辞之间的答案波动大于同文本重复，且通常跟随被改表格所隐含的目标答案。
arxiv.reason: 评测方法学：规则迁移与信息利用的可控测量，与评估可靠性擦边

arxiv.title: HGM-Dual: Lineage-Aware Guided Agent Harness Optimization for Long-Horizon Planning
arxiv.abstract: Harness optimization, which improves an agent's prompts, tools, and workflows, is an increasingly effective way to enhance agents built on frozen or closed-source LLMs. Leading approaches such as the Darwin--Godel Machine and the Huxley--Godel Machine (HGM) rely on recursive self-improvement and were developed mainly for coding, where the competence needed to improve the agent coincides with the competence being improved. Planning tasks, in which an agent must produce a sequence of tool calls that jointly satisfies interacting constraints, break this alignment. There, open-ended self-modification repeatedly explores ineffective changes and consumes substantial evaluation budgets. We introduce HGM-Dual, a diagnostic-guided framework for budget-efficient harness evolution for planning agents. First, HGM-Dual represents agent evolution as lineage-aware context. This context records what each ancestor changed, which behaviors improved or regressed, and which modifications were ineffective, giving the editor explicit edit-outcome attribution instead of an unstructured archive of past agents. Second, HGM-Dual introduces error-conditioned dual-path child generation. For each selected parent, it generates a general child that preserves open-ended exploration and specialized children that target the harness components most likely responsible for the parent's highest-ranked constraint violations. HGM-Dual outperforms the strongest baseline by up to 14.45% relative improvement in case accuracy while matching HGM variants' final performance with 2x-4x fewer evaluation budget.
arxiv.titleZh: HGM-Dual:面向长时程规划的谱系感知引导式 Agent Harness 优化
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对规划类 Agent 的 harness(提示、工具、工作流)自动优化问题:Darwin-Gödel Machine、HGM 等递归自我改进方法依赖「改进所需能力与被改进能力重合」的编码场景，在需要产出满足交互约束的工具调用序列的规划任务上会反复探索无效改动、消耗大量评估预算。HGM-Dual 将 Agent 进化表示为谱系感知上下文，记录每个祖先改动了什么、哪些行为提升或退化、哪些修改无效，使编辑者获得显式的编辑—结果归因;并引入错误条件双路径子代生成，为每个被选父代同时产出保留开放探索的通用子代与针对最高排名约束违反所对应 harness 组件的专用子代。在规划任务上，case accuracy 相对最强基线最高提升 14.45%，并以 2x-4x 更少的评估预算达到 HGM 变体的最终性能。该工作将 harness 自动搜索从编码扩展到约束耦合的规划场景，适用于以冻结或闭源 LLM 构建 Agent 的工程场景。
arxiv.reason: Agent harness 自动优化，谱系归因与双路径生成机制新颖，命中 Agent 方向

arxiv.title: Robust Soft Skill Adaptation via Behavioral Localization in Tool-Using Agents
arxiv.abstract: Text skills can extend the capabilities of tool-using agents, but long skill descriptions increase computational costs. Soft prompts provide a compact alternative, yet learning from entire successful trajectories may also introduce unnecessary behavioral changes. We find that the useful effect of a text skill is highly concentrated in a small subset of trajectory positions. Based on this observation, we propose Behavioral Localization, which compares the frozen agent with and without the text skill to identify positions where the skill both increases the likelihood of successful tokens and meaningfully changes the next token distribution. We use these localized positions to supervise a short soft prompt. Experiments on SpreadsheetBench with a frozen Qwen3.6-35B-A3B agent show that the top 10\% of trajectory positions capture 96.12\% of the total positive skill gain. In the shared prompt setting, selective supervision improves success from 30.36\% with full trajectory to 36.79\%. Under task-specific conditions, using the top 10\% localized positions achieves 57.38\%, outperforming both the full text skill and the on-policy OPCD baseline. These results show that a small set of behaviorally relevant trajectory positions can provide effective supervision of soft skills.
arxiv.titleZh: 工具使用 Agent 中通过行为定位实现稳健的软技能适配
arxiv.summaryZh: 工具使用 Agent 可以用文本技能扩展能力，但长技能描述会抬高推理开销；软提示虽然紧凑，却会从整条成功轨迹中学习，从而引入多余的行为改变。该方法通过对比带文本技能和不带文本技能的冻结 Agent，定位到既提升成功 token 似然、又显著改变下一个 token 分布的位置，再用这些位置监督一段短软提示。在 SpreadsheetBench 上以冻结的 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 验证：前 10% 的位置占总正向技能增益的 96.12%；共享提示设置下成功率由 30.36% 升至 36.79%，任务特定设置下前 10% 定位位置达 57.38%，超过完整文本技能与 on-policy OPCD 基线。少量行为相关位置即可有效监督软技能。
arxiv.reason: 工具型 Agent 的软技能适配，定位式监督思路清晰有数据

arxiv.title: What the Author Wrote, What the Agent Reads: Silent Cue Loss in Enterprise Document Ingestion
arxiv.abstract: Enterprise agents act on documents. Before an agent can follow a policy, answer a compliance question or file a ticket, some ingestion layer must turn a Word file or PDF into tokens - and that layer is where an agent deployed in the wild silently loses information. We show that one layer is lost by every mainstream converter - the meaning an author encodes in how text looks - and that the loss makes agents confidently wrong rather than visibly incomplete. We build a task from 76 real policy documents: recover the requirements the author singled out, scored against the file's own OOXML properties by a deterministic matcher with no LLM judge. Formatting-blind ingestion collapses from micro F1 0.690 to 0.150 (docling) and 0.075 (plain text), a gap that replicates across six answering models from two vendors - five Claude models spanning the Opus, Sonnet and Haiku tiers, and OpenAI's GPT-5.6. An agent that cannot see the cue guesses, and docling's false-positive rate on requirements the author did not flag is four times ours. A span-level leave-one-out localises the loss to two cues - highlight (+0.302) and colour (+0.262), both Holm-adjusted p < 1e-4 - while bold, italic, monospace and strikethrough each sit within +/-0.003 of zero. The same asymmetry appears in PDF. Colour is also the cue no mainstream converter preserves and no parsing benchmark scores, and it is common: 32.8% of 6,460 documents carry a deliberate colour or highlight, 10.3% on an obligation. A pre-registered test shows that typing a cue for the agent adds +0.085 beyond merely preserving it (Holm-adjusted p = 0.049). We validate the labels against rendered page images through an independent modality (kappa = 0.72) and bound what wording alone can achieve (AUC 0.664). For agent builders the practical finding is that ingestion, not reasoning, is where this reliability is won or lost, and that the fix is cheap and measurable.
arxiv.titleZh: 作者写了什么，Agent 读到了什么：企业文档摄取中的静默线索丢失
arxiv.summaryZh: 企业Agent依赖摄取层把Word/PDF转成token，而该层会静默丢掉作者用格式（高亮、颜色）编码的含义，使Agent自信地答错。工作基于76份真实政策文档构造任务，以文件自身OOXML属性为标签、用确定性匹配器打分，不依赖LLM判官；格式盲的摄取让micro F1从0.690跌至0.150（docling）与0.075（纯文本），并在六個答题模型上复现。span级leave-one-out把损失定位到高亮（+0.302）与颜色（+0.262），加粗、斜体等接近0；6,460份文档中32.8%带有刻意颜色或高亮。结论是这层可靠性赢在摄取而非推理，且修复代价低、可度量。
arxiv.reason: Agent文档摄取可靠性实证，方法严谨，命中Agent与评测方向

arxiv.title: ExGrad: Beyond Suppression - Explicit Clean-Gradient Subtraction in Adversarial Training
arxiv.abstract: Adversarial training derives updates from surrogate losses, but source-loss descent does not directly characterize an update's effect on adversarial margins. We introduce ExGrad (extrapolative gradient recomposition), which constructs clean-input, adversarial-input, and adversarial-weight-perturbed (AWP) gradients. Virtual steps measure their margin responses, and a globally solvable three-variable problem selects coefficients over a bounded affine domain without nonnegativity constraints. Across affine radii on CIFAR-10, negative clean coefficients rapidly predominate and increase in magnitude with the radius. Cross-zero interventions show that setting the clean coefficient to zero is insufficient: mild subtraction improves PGD-20, while stronger subtraction trades clean accuracy for further PGD-20 gains. In CIFAR-10 WRN-28-4 controls, none of the three candidate-removal variants matches full ExGrad. Projection diagnostics show that negative clean coefficients usually coexist with positive net clean-axis projections, although both decrease as the radius grows. Norm-matched controls indicate that update magnitude alone does not explain the moderate-radius gains. Experiments on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and ImageNet-100 show radius-dependent improvements over AWP. On CIFAR-100, ExGrad at $R=0.8$ improves all five reported metrics, including clean and AutoAttack accuracy by 3.84 and 1.75 percentage points. On ImageNet-100, the same radius improves all four robust metrics over both AWP and PGD-AT. These results identify clean-gradient subtraction as a response-revealed update preference whose strength and clean-robust operating point are controlled by the affine radius.
arxiv.titleZh: ExGrad：超越抑制——对抗训练中的显式干净梯度相减
arxiv.summaryZh: 对抗训练依赖替代损失的下降方向，却不能直接刻画更新对对抗间隔的影响。ExGrad 同时构造干净输入、对抗输入与 AWP 梯度，用虚拟步测量各方向的间隔响应，在有界仿射域上求解三元系数且不强制非负，发现负的干净梯度系数随半径增大而占主导。CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100、ImageNet-100 上相对 AWP 取得随半径变化的提升：CIFAR-100 在 R=0.8 时干净精度与 AutoAttack 精度分别提高 3.84 和 1.75 个百分点，ImageNet-100 的四项鲁棒指标也同步改善，说明干净梯度相减是一种由响应揭示、可由半径调节的更新偏好。
arxiv.reason: 对抗训练与视觉鲁棒性，偏离 LLM 后训练与 Agent 方向

arxiv.title: GuideEvolve: Self-Evolving Agent Framework with Expert Guidance and 3Ts Mechanisms
arxiv.abstract: This study introduces GuideEvolve, a self-evolving agent framework incorporating expert guidance and three autonomous regulatory mechanisms, collectively termed the 3Ts: Think Fast and Slow, Throwback, and Termination by choice. The framework addresses critical limitations in extant self-evolving agent paradigms through dual innovations: (1) a task-specific expert-evaluation-driven evolutionary pipeline, and (2) the integration of 3Ts mechanisms to facilitate cognitive optimization, performance recovery via temporal rollback, and adaptive termination protocols. Empirical validation across the MGSM and MMLU benchmarks demonstrates that GuideEvolve attains performance metrics comparable to current state-of-the-art models (89.8% accuracy versus Gödel Agent's 90.6% on MGSM; 89.1% versus 87.9% on MMLU), while exhibiting notably reduced variance (25-59%) and enhanced robustness. Furthermore, the framework achieves a 100% evolution success rate, superior to the baseline's 82%, diminishes required optimization iterations by approximately 50% (from 30 iterations in baseline to 15.1 and 13.4 across tasks), and provides improved stability for production deployment.
arxiv.titleZh: GuideEvolve:融合专家指导与3Ts机制的自进化Agent框架
arxiv.summaryZh: 自进化Agent在稳定性与进化成功率上存在明显短板。GuideEvolve引入任务特定的专家评估驱动进化流水线，并加入3Ts机制——快慢思考、时间回溯回滚、自适应终止，以支持认知优化、性能恢复与按需停止。在MGSM上准确率89.8%(Gödel Agent为90.6%)，在MMLU上89.1%(对比87.9%)，方差降低25–59%，进化成功率达100%，优化迭代从30轮降到13–15轮。该工作面向Agent自我改进的工程稳定性，适用于生产环境部署。
arxiv.reason: 自进化Agent框架，属Agent与自我改进方向，方法较扎实

arxiv.title: Code Comprehensor: Hierarchical Documentation and Cross-Modal Retrieval for Large Repositories
arxiv.abstract: Understanding large, complex, and rapidly evolving code bases remains a core challenge for software engineering at scale, hindering onboarding, maintenance, refactoring, and impact analysis. Providing this information to a Large-Language Model (LLM) is another hurdle, as the LLM must understand not only the required code method but also its associated methods in the grand scheme of the repository. We propose Code Comprehensor, a hybrid retrieval-reasoning framework combining (i) a code dependency callgraph, (ii) CodeScribe, which uses code-aware LLMs to generate hierarchical documentation across repository call graphs, and (iii) CodeContrast, a CLIP-style dual-encoder model trained on CodeScribe output to learn aligned text-code embeddings. CodeContrast enables fast, semantically precise retrieval of relevant code-context neighborhoods, which serve as grounded evidence for an MCP-based LLM orchestrator answering domain-specific queries. Evaluation on OpenCV and a proprietary 5M-LOC repository shows that CodeScribe-derived supervision significantly improves cross-modal retrieval in text-to-code accuracy over baseline approaches. Richer textual supervision (hierarchical documentation, parent/sibling context, and LLM-generated synthetic questions) consistently enhances performance across both repositories. LLM-as-a-judge evaluation using the popular RAGAS of the Code Comprehensor output yields above 90% faithfulness scores.
arxiv.comment: Accepted at 42nd International Conference on Software Maintenance and Evolution
arxiv.titleZh: Code Comprehensor:面向大型代码仓库的层次化文档与跨模态检索
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对大型代码库难以理解、仓库级上下文难以喂给LLM的问题，用依赖调用图组织仓库结构，CodeScribe借助code-aware LLM沿调用图生成层次化文档，CodeContrast以CLIP式双编码器在该文档监督下学习对齐的文本-代码嵌入，从而快速检索语义相关的代码上下文邻域，交给基于MCP的LLM编排器作为证据作答。在OpenCV与500万行私有仓库上，该监督显著提升text-to-code检索准确率，层次化文档、父/兄弟上下文与LLM合成问题均带来一致增益，RAGAS忠实度超过90%。
arxiv.reason: 代码仓库RAG与检索，沾代码智能方向，但偏SE工程实现

arxiv.title: Agent Behavior Maps: Locating Agents by What They Would Do, Without Running Them
arxiv.abstract: LLM agents with similar success rates can follow different action sequences. An Agent Behavior Map represents LLM-harness combinations using centered action log-likelihoods on shared reference trajectories, without requiring new environment rollouts from the target agent. We derive error bounds relating squared coordinate distances to trajectory KL under explicit assumptions, and across eight cross-scored models the distances track the directly measured trajectory KL in rank order. Across 100 LLMs and four environments, ALFWorld-based coordinates support performance prediction and identify behavioral similarities. In ALFWorld, these similarities persist after controlling for success rates and model size, including across model families. As an extension, harness-component displacements approximately compose, with accuracy varying across components and environments.
arxiv.titleZh: Agent Behavior Maps:通过行为倾向定位智能体，无需实际运行
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对成功率相近的 LLM agent 可能执行完全不同的动作序列这一问题，提出 Agent Behavior Map:在共享参考轨迹上，用中心化的动作对数似然为 LLM-harness 组合建立坐标表示，无需对目标 agent 做新的环境 rollout。理论推导给出坐标平方距离与轨迹 KL 的误差界，八个交叉评分模型的坐标距离与直接测量的轨迹 KL 在秩次上一致;在 100 个 LLM、四个环境上验证，ALFWorld 坐标可预测性能并识别行为相似性，且在控制成功率与模型规模后相似性仍跨模型家族保持。该方法为 agent 行为刻画与 harness 组件分析提供了低成本、可组合的定位工具。
arxiv.reason: Agent 行为表征与 harness 分析，方法新颖且系统性强

arxiv.title: Mitigating Model Collapse through Dreaming Learning
arxiv.abstract: Training generative models on synthetic data causes loss of diversity and a decrease in performance, a phenomenon known as model collapse. We study this degeneration spectrally in a controlled Markov setting. The eigenvalue spectrum of the learned transition operator offers a direct view of the process, since the subdominant eigenvalues set how fast the chain mixes and therefore how much of the state space it continues to explore. We find that sampling at temperature $T_s < 1$ acts on the operator like repeated sharpening, pushing it toward a deterministic system: the subdominant eigenvalues approach the unit circle and the spectral gap narrows. When $T_s < 1$, even data accumulation does not appear to arrest this drift. We then analyze Dreaming Learning, a regulariser that, in parallel with regular training, adds a loss term on the model's own samples drawn at a raised temperature $T_d > 1$. Because high-temperature samples flatten the predicted distribution, training on them keeps the entries of the learned operator from becoming vanishingly small, which in turn keeps the eigenvalues bounded away from the unit circle. Measurements of the spectra over 5000 generations are consistent with this picture, and the mitigation effect persists in more complex settings such as LSTM language models and a 124M-parameter GPT-2.
arxiv.comment: 8 pages, 6 figures. Accepted at the 2nd Workshop on Principles of Generative Modeling (PriGM), NeurIPS 2026
arxiv.titleZh: 通过Dreaming Learning缓解模型坍缩
arxiv.summaryZh: 用合成数据训练生成模型会导致多样性丧失与性能下降，即模型坍缩；在可控马尔可夫设定下从谱角度分析，发现低温采样（T_s<1）相当于反复锐化学习到的转移算子，使次主特征值逼近单位圆、谱隙收窄，且即使累积数据也无法阻止这种漂移。Dreaming Learning在常规训练外，对模型以更高温度T_d>1自采样并加入损失项，高温样本会平坦化预测分布，避免算子元素变得过小，从而把特征值约束在离单位圆更远处。5000代谱测量与该解释一致，并在LSTM语言模型和124M参数GPT-2上观察到缓解效果。该工作为合成数据与自训练场景下的模型坍缩提供了可解释的正则化机制。
arxiv.reason: 模型坍缩与自训练正则化，贴合预训练与自进化方向

arxiv.title: Building Auditable AI Text Detectors with Sparse Autoencoders
arxiv.abstract: AI-generated text detectors are increasingly deployed in consequential settings---peer review, education, admissions, journalism, and content moderation---where their outputs directly affect individuals. Yet the strongest detectors are fine-tuned neural classifiers whose decisions are opaque, while transparent alternatives (stylometric and linguistic-feature classifiers) underperform them by wide margins. We present a pipeline that converts a fine-tuned neural detector into a classifier that operates on human-readable concepts. We accomplish this by training sparse autoencoders (SAEs) directly on a detector's residual stream, assigning auto-interpretation labels to each SAE feature, and retaining only features whose generated descriptions pass a global fidelity threshold. We then train a lightweight classifier on just the interpretable features. We find that our SAEs recover latent concepts that correspond to highly specific and predictive linguistic "tells" of AI-generated text. Classifiers built on these extracted features are not only highly interpretable but exhibit stronger performance on out-of-distribution texts than either neural or stylometric alternatives.
arxiv.titleZh: 用稀疏自编码器构建可审计的 AI 文本检测器
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对强 AI 文本检测器（微调神经分类器）决策不透明、而可解释的文体学与语言学特征分类器性能大幅落后的矛盾，在检测器残差流上直接训练稀疏自编码器（SAE），用自动解释为每个 SAE 特征生成标签，仅保留描述通过全局保真度阈值的特征，再基于这些可读概念训练轻量分类器。结果显示 SAE 恢复出的潜在概念对应高度具体且具预测力的 AI 文本「破绽」，所得分类器不仅可解释，在分布外文本上的表现也优于神经与文体学基线。适用于同行评审、教育、招生、新闻与内容审核等需要可审计判定的场景。
arxiv.reason: SAE 可解释性用于 AI 文本检测，方法清晰但属交叉应用

arxiv.title: EPIC: Rethinking Trust Regions for Autoregressive LLM Policies via Exact-KL Prefix Importance-Ratio Clipping
arxiv.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) based on PPO-style clipping has become an effective approach to improving the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs). However, standard token-level clipping measures policy change only through the conditional probability of the current token, while the prefix conditioning context is itself generated by the policy. This mismatch becomes especially consequential in long-response and off-policy training. We reformulate autoregressive generation as a finite-horizon Markov decision process and derive its performance-difference identity under behavior-policy sampling. The resulting change of measure identifies the cumulative likelihood ratio of the generated prefix as the exact importance weight for each stepwise policy-improvement term. Starting from the monotonic-improvement principle of trust-region policy optimization, we then construct a prefix-level trust region using the exact reverse-KL coordinate $r-1-\log r$, whose behavior-policy expectation equals the corresponding prefix-distribution KL divergence. This yields EPIC, a PPO-style sequence-clipping method that directly regulates prefix-level policy drift without relying on a local quadratic approximation or expert-routing replay. Experiments on off-policy reinforcement learning with a sparse mixture-of-experts language model show that EPIC consistently outperforms standard and sequence-level clipping baselines across mathematical-reasoning benchmarks, while remaining competitive with routing-replay-based alternatives. Code is available at https://github.com/LiChengxi666/EPIC.
arxiv.titleZh: EPIC:通过精确 KL 前缀重要性比裁剪重新审视自回归 LLM 策略的信赖域
arxiv.summaryZh: PPO 式裁剪仅以当前 token 的条件概率衡量策略变化，而条件所依赖的前缀本身由策略生成，该错配在长回答与 off-policy 训练下尤为突出。EPIC 将自回归生成改写为有限时域 MDP，推导行为策略采样下的性能差恒等式，指明生成前缀的累积似然比才是每步策略改进项的精确重要性权重;并以精确 reverse-KL 坐标 r−1−log r 构造前缀级信赖域(其行为策略期望等于前缀分布 KL)，得到直接约束前缀级策略漂移的序列裁剪方法，无需局部二次近似或专家路由重放。在稀疏 MoE 语言模型的 off-policy 强化学习实验中，该方法在数学推理基准上稳定优于标准裁剪与序列级裁剪基线，并与基于路由重放的方案持平。
arxiv.reason: 重構 PPO 裁剪为前缀级精确 KL 信赖域，直接命中 LLM 后训练 RL

arxiv.title: HiddenLens: A Multi-Layer LLM Framework for Detecting and Resolving Hidden Assumptions in Software Requirements
arxiv.abstract: Natural-language software requirements often omit assumptions about performance, operating conditions, user behaviour, and domain constraints, affecting architecture, testing, and deployment. If undiscovered until implementation, resolving them is far more costly than addressing them early. Although ambiguity and vagueness are widely studied, less attention has been given to assumptions embedded in requirements that appear clear and reasonable. We propose HiddenLens, a novel six-layer BERT-LLM pipeline and, to our knowledge, the first framework engineered to detect, classify, question, and resolve hidden assumptions rather than merely flag ambiguity. Layer 1 uses BERT attention entropy to localise unresolved spans; Layer 2 uses CoT-prompted LLM reasoning to articulate each assumption and its failure risk; Layer 3 uses fine-tuned BERT to classify assumptions into six non-functional requirement categories: performance, security, scalability, usability, reliability, and domain; Layer 4 generates ranked clarification options using FS LLM prompting; Layer 5 enables human validation through confirmation, editing, or rephrasing; and Layer 6 rewrites the requirement using the confirmed resolution, producing an explicit, testable, and traceable requirement. We also introduce the HiddenLens Corpus (HLC), comprising 312 requirements annotated with 847 hidden assumptions across six NFR categories. Inspired by PROMISE and PURE, HLC addresses the lack of annotated data for this task and is, to our knowledge, the first dataset developed specifically for it. HiddenLens outperforms keyword-based and QuARS-Adapted baselines by 71% and 61%, respectively, achieving an end-to-end F1-score of 0.79; its BERT-based NFR classifier achieves an F1-score of 0.847. These results indicate that HiddenLens can help analysts resolve hidden assumptions before they propagate through software development.
arxiv.titleZh: HiddenLens：一个用于检测与消解软件需求中隐藏假设的多层LLM框架
arxiv.summaryZh: 自然语言软件需求常隐含性能、运行条件、用户行为与领域约束等未言明的假设，若到实现阶段才暴露，修复代价远高于早期澄清。HiddenLens构建六层BERT-LLM流水线：第1层用BERT注意力熵定位未明确的文本片段，第2层用CoT提示的LLM推理阐述每条假设及其失效风险，第3层用微调BERT把假设归入性能、安全、可扩展性、可用性、可靠性、领域六类非功能需求，第4层生成排序后的澄清选项，第5层由人工确认、编辑或重述，第6层据此重写为明确、可测试、可追溯的需求。工作同时发布HiddenLens Corpus，含312条需求与847条标注隐藏假设；端到端F1为0.79，较关键词基线与QuARS-Adapted基线分别提升71%和61%，NFR分类器F1达0.847。
arxiv.reason: LLM用于软件需求分析，属垂直应用，与核心方向仅擦边

arxiv.title: Remembering Through Change: Provenance-Preserving Hypergraph Memory for Multimodal Agents
arxiv.abstract: Long-term memory for multimodal agents remains challenging, as it must preserve fine-grained visual evidence while tracking entity evolution across sessions. Existing abstraction-based memories compress images into text, often discarding visually discriminative details, whereas pixel-preserving memories retain raw observations but struggle to reliably associate diverse observations with persistent entity identities and track their evolving states. To address these limitations, we propose MHG-Mem, a multimodal hypergraph memory that jointly organizes entity identity, state evolution, and provenance to visual evidence. Specifically, MHG-Mem represents distinct entity mentions and their observed facts as individual nodes, grouping identity-consistent mentions and facts through occurrence hyperedges. It then synthesizes aspect-specific evolution states from these grouped observations and links them to supporting entities, facts, and source evidence through evolutionary and evidential hyperedges. To navigate this structured memory, we introduce hypergraph-based agentic search, which adaptively selects an entry layer, traverses typed hyperedges across memory levels, and inspects source observations when fine-grained verification is required. These designs support both detailed visual verification and reasoning over cross-session state changes. Extensive experiments across three benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of MHG-Mem, improving performance by 8.20-9.98% over the strongest baseline.
arxiv.titleZh: 在变化中记忆：面向多模态智能体的保源超图记忆
arxiv.summaryZh: 多模态智能体的长期记忆需要在保留细粒度视觉证据的同时跟踪跨会话的实体状态演化：文本抽象式记忆会丢失有判别力的视觉细节，像素保留式记忆则难以把分散观测绑定到稳定的实体身份。MHG-Mem 将实体提及、观测事实与视觉证据统一组织为超图：用出现超边聚合身份一致的提及与事实，据此合成各侧面的演化状态，并通过演化超边与证据超边连接到支撑实体、事实与源观测；检索侧提出基于超图的智能体搜索，自适应选择入口层、跨层遍历类型化超边，并在需要细粒度核验时回看原始观测。三个 benchmark 上的实验在最强基线基础上提升 8.20%–9.98%。
arxiv.reason: 多模态智能体记忆的结构化建模与检索，命中 Agent 记忆方向

arxiv.title: SCDM: Scalable Causal Discovery in Nonlinear Temporal Systems with Meta-Learning
arxiv.abstract: Causal discovery from nonlinear multivariate time series is challenging in high-dimensional systems, where the number of candidate directed relations grows quadratically with the number of variables. Existing methods are often limited by target-wise model fitting, repeated conditional testing, or expensive graph-search procedures. We propose SCDM, a shared-parameter meta-learning framework for scalable temporal causal discovery. SCDM treats each target variable as a task while learning a shared temporal predictor and a shared causal-strength matrix across tasks. Each meta-episode updates only a subset of target-variable tasks, allowing the model to accumulate structural evidence across the full system without exhaustive target-wise optimization. After training, a post-training graph readout converts the learned predictor into continuous directed causal scores for threshold-independent evaluation. We also provide a finite-error recovery principle showing that, under fully observed delayed-system assumptions and a positive risk-gap condition, thresholding SCDM scores recovers the graph when statistical, meta-optimization, and readout errors are below the population margin. Experiments on controlled synthetic, neuroimaging-inspired, high-dimensional, and real-world temporal benchmarks demonstrate competitive causal recovery and improved scalability in large temporal systems.
arxiv.titleZh: SCDM：基于元学习的非线性时序系统可扩展因果发现
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对高维非线性多元时间序列的因果发现问题：候选有向关系随变量数平方增长，现有方法受限于逐目标建模、重复条件检验或昂贵的图搜索。SCDM 将每个目标变量视作一个元学习任务，跨任务共享时序预测器与因果强度矩阵，每个 meta-episode 只更新部分目标任务，从而避免穷举式的逐目标优化；训练后由图读出把预测器转为连续有向因果分数，支持与阈值无关的评估。理论上给出有限误差恢复原则：在完全观测的延迟系统与正风险间隔条件下，只要统计误差、元优化误差与读出误差均低于总体间隔，阈值化即可恢复真实图。在受控合成、类神经影像、高维与真实时序基准上因果恢复效果有竞争力，大规模系统上的可扩展性更好。
arxiv.reason: 时序因果发现方法，与 LLM 及后训练、Agent 方向基本无交集

arxiv.title: TIDE: Tree-Induced Fine-Grained Diagnostic Evaluation from Model Behaviors
arxiv.abstract: Benchmark performance is the dominant standard for comparing large language models (LLMs), typically summarized by a single aggregate score, such as accuracy, pass rate, or rubric score. This aggregate score provides limited information about a model's underlying capabilities, yet understanding these capabilities is crucial for model development and evaluation. To this end, we propose Tree-Induced Diagnostic Evaluation (TIDE), which recasts diagnostic evaluation as behavior-driven decision-tree induction to perform fine-grained capability diagnosis. TIDE recursively builds a hierarchical capability tree from benchmark samples and model scores: at each node, an LLM judge proposes candidate splits and performs sample-to-group classification, and behavior-based information gain selects among them. We apply TIDE to five models across four benchmarks to demonstrate its effectiveness, and find fine-grained capability contrasts invisible at the aggregate level: Claude Opus 4.6 achieves 100% on microeconomic market reasoning where GPT-5.4 scores 83.3%, but trails GPT-5.4 on contract law reasoning with 77.8% versus 88.9%. We hope TIDE can be extended to past and future benchmarks so that the rich behavioral signal in evaluation results is fully leveraged for understanding model capabilities.
arxiv.titleZh: TIDE：从模型行为出发的树诱导细粒度诊断评测
arxiv.summaryZh: 聚合分数（准确率、通过率、rubric 得分）无法揭示模型能力的内部结构。TIDE 将诊断评测重构为行为驱动的决策树归纳：从基准样本与模型得分出发递归构建层级能力树，每个节点由 LLM judge 提出候选划分并完成样本归类，再用基于行为的信息增益挑选划分。在四个基准、五个模型上，它能显现聚合层面看不到的细粒度反差，如 Claude Opus 4.6 在微观经济学市场推理上达 100%、GPT-5.4 为 83.3%，但在合同法推理上 77.8% 落后于后者的 88.9%。该流程可迁移到已有与未来基准，充分挖掘评测结果中的行为信号。
arxiv.reason: 细粒度能力诊断的评测方法，LLM-as-judge 驱动，命中评测方向

arxiv.title: FaultGene: LLM-Assisted Fault-Augmented Test Generation for Hardware-in-the-Loop Validation of Autonomous Driving Systems
arxiv.abstract: Reliable validation of autonomous driving cyber-physical systems requires testing not only nominal driving behavior but also failures arising from faults in sensing and embedded computation. Physical road testing provides realistic system behavior but is costly and difficult to reproduce, while simulation enables scalable evaluation but cannot fully capture hardware-dependent behavior and fault propagation. Hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) validation bridges this gap by executing the driving stack on real embedded hardware within a simulated environment. However, preparing fault-augmented scenarios for HIL testing remains largely a manual process, limiting test coverage, scalability, and efficiency. We present FaultGene, an LLM-assisted framework for automated generation of executable fault-augmented tests for HIL fault-resilience validation. Given a baseline Scenic/CARLA scenario and a structured fault specification, FaultGene generates a fault-augmented test case that captures the effects of HIL-level fault injection. During offline refinement, semantic-consistency checks and execution-level feedback are used to correct candidates that fail to preserve the intended scenario context or produce the desired fault-induced degradation, and to construct high-quality supervision for fine-tuning. The resulting generator then produces fault-augmented tests directly at deployment time without requiring manually engineered reference executions or repeated refinement loops.
arxiv.titleZh: FaultGene：LLM 辅助的故障增强测试生成，用于自动驾驶系统的硬件在环验证
arxiv.summaryZh: 硬件在环（HIL）测试需要带有故障注入的可执行场景，而这类场景长期依赖人工编写，覆盖度与可扩展性受限。FaultGene 以 Scenic/CARLA 基线场景与结构化故障规格为输入，先生成候选测试用例，再通过语义一致性检查与执行级反馈进行离线迭代修正，并把修正结果构造为高质量监督数据用于微调。微调后的生成器在部署阶段可直接产出故障增强测试，无需人工参考执行或重复精修循环。工作面向自动驾驶 CPS 的故障韧性验证流程自动化。
arxiv.reason: LLM 用于自动驾驶 HIL 测试生成，属垂直领域应用

arxiv.title: CulturalRiddles: A Multicultural Benchmark of Riddles
arxiv.abstract: As LLMs expand their language coverage, evaluating how well they understand and represent diverse cultures becomes increasingly important. However, many benchmarks remain English-centric, with limited cultural coverage and a focus on factual knowledge over its application in real-world cultural contexts. We propose CulturalRiddles, a benchmark of original, culturally grounded riddles created entirely by humans through a participatory community effort, spanning 62 cultures (45 countries, 51 languages). These riddles are deeply rooted in their respective cultures and require abductive and compositional reasoning, alongside detailed factual and social knowledge, language skills, and an understanding of culturally specific associations. We benchmark 28 LLM configurations using both automatic and large-scale human evaluation. Even frontier models achieve at most 22% accuracy in some communities. We publicly release all artifacts alongside an open contribution process to expand the benchmark's linguistic and cultural coverage.
arxiv.titleZh: CulturalRiddles：一个多文化谜语基准
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有 LLM 文化评测多为英语中心、文化覆盖有限，且偏重事实性知识而非其在真实文化语境中的应用。该工作通过社区参与式众包，完全由人工创作了扎根于本土文化的谜语基准，覆盖 62 种文化、45 个国家、51 种语言，解题需要溯因与组合推理、细致的事实与社会知识、语言能力以及对文化特定联想的把握。对 28 种 LLM 配置进行自动评测与大规模人工评测，结果显示即使前沿模型在某些社群上的准确率最高仅 22%。全部数据与代码已公开，并提供开放贡献流程以扩展语种与文化覆盖，为多语言文化理解评测提供了可复用的方法学范式。
arxiv.reason: 多语言文化评测基准，含大规模人工评测，属评测方法学扎实工作

arxiv.title: CORD: Conflict-Aware Optimization for Joint RL and Distillation in Agents
arxiv.abstract: Joint reinforcement learning and self-distillation combines task rewards with dense teacher guidance for agent training, but their gradients can partly cancel. A mixing coefficient controls relative scale without selectively removing opposing components. We present CORD, a general framework for conflict-aware optimization of two objectives. CORD separates the choice of protected objective from the condition that triggers projection, and combines the gradients once per optimizer mini-batch. A nearest-point formulation yields a closed-form update and characterizes its first-order effect on the protected objective before optimizer transformations. Gradient diagnostics connect conflict in agent training to lost local optimization progress and motivate selective correction. As a gradient-combination mechanism, CORD can be added to different joint training recipes while retaining their objectives. Across three such recipes, it improves ALFWorld success by 1.5-15.9 percentage points. On WebShop, it improves two of the three pairs, with SDAR rising from 60.7% to 64.6% success. Our analyses explain why protection direction and projection gate must be chosen together, and why the distillation objective and its mixing weight remain consequential after projection.
arxiv.titleZh: CORD：Agent中RL与蒸馏联合训练的冲突感知优化
arxiv.summaryZh: 联合RL与自蒸馏训练Agent时，任务奖励梯度与教师指导梯度可能部分相互抵消，而用混合系数只调整相对尺度、无法选择性去掉对立分量。CORD把「受保护目标的选择」与「触发投影的条件」分开，在每个optimizer mini-batch上合并一次梯度：通过最近点建模得到闭式更新，并在optimizer变换前刻画其对受保护目标的一阶影响；梯度诊断把Agent训练中的冲突与局部优化进展损失联系起来，从而支持选择性修正。作为梯度合并机制，CORD可嵌入三种联合训练方案并保留原目标，在ALFWorld上成功率提升1.5–15.9个百分点，WebShop上三组中有两组提升，SDAR由60.7%升至64.6%。分析表明保护方向与投影门控必须协同选取，且投影后蒸馏目标及其混合权重仍然关键。
arxiv.reason: Agentic RL与蒸馏联合训练的梯度冲突修正，属后训练核心方向

arxiv.title: Commit or Abstain? System One Decision Models, LLMs, and Missing Legal Authority
arxiv.abstract: Given the enormous number of claims to be checked, verifiable legal AI requires scalable, cost-effective models that answer the practical needs of law. System One decision models are built on large language models but, instead of generating text, return a calibrated probability for each option. This suits the verification of legal authority, where the question is closed: a given holding, or none of them. We test whether such models abstain when the correct authority is missing. We extend CaseHOLD with an abstention condition in which the correct holding is replaced in 1,670 of 5,314 items, and compare four decision models with six generative LLMs. When no option is correct, generative LLMs still pick one in 38-86% of items; the most cautious decision model does so in 30%. On standard CaseHOLD, a decision model matches the best generative LLM (88.1% vs. 88.2%) at 1/55 of the cost. Accepting that LLM's answer only when a decision model agrees halves its wrong citations, and distilling a decision model's probabilities into Qwen3-8B, without labels, yields a well-calibrated local model. Legal AI should be judged by its wrong citations, not by accuracy alone.
arxiv.comment: 16 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables. Under review. Code, data, and model outputs: https://github.com/mmikaildemir/commit-or-abstain
arxiv.titleZh: 提交还是弃权？System One 决策模型、LLM 与缺失的法律依据
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对法律依据核验这类封闭选项任务，构建基于LLM但不生成文本、直接输出各选项校准概率的 System One 决策模型，并把 CaseHOLD 扩展出弃权条件（5314 题中 1670 题替换掉正确判例）。对比 4 个决策模型与 6 个生成式 LLM：无正确选项时生成式模型仍有 38–86% 强行选择，最谨慎的决策模型为 30%；标准 CaseHOLD 上决策模型以 88.1% 持平最佳生成模型 88.2%，成本仅 1/55。仅在决策模型与 LLM 答案一致时采纳，可把错误引用减半；无需标签即可将决策模型概率蒸馏进 Qwen3-8B，得到校准良好的本地模型。
arxiv.reason: 弃权校准与无标签概率蒸馏有方法价值，但落在法律垂直应用

arxiv.title: Towards English - Mizo Legal Machine Translation: Corpus Creation, Analysis, and Benchmarks
arxiv.abstract: Indian court proceedings are held in English, so speakers of languages with limited translation technology have limited access to them. We present the first English Mizo parallel dataset of Indian court judgments. It contains 13,168 sentence pairs from the Gauhati High Court and the Supreme Court of India. Professional native Mizo translators translated complete documents; sentence pairs were manually aligned, and two independent reviewers checked the results. Our study finds that English words are borrowed in a very selective way: official and legal terms are almost always kept in English, but words for everyday things like actions, situations, and results are usually expressed in native Mizo. Mizo diacritics are also used inconsistently across the corpus. When we fine tune the NLLB 200 1.3B model on our training data, it scores 27.47 BLEU on a balanced legal test set of 1,000 sentence pairs, an improvement of 7.16 BLEU over the base model. However, it still uses English words about three times more often than a human translator does.
arxiv.titleZh: 面向英语—米佐语法律机器翻译：语料库构建、分析与基准
arxiv.summaryZh: 印度法院庭审与判决以英文进行，低资源语言使用者难以获取这些内容，而英语—米佐语缺乏平行语料与翻译系统。该工作构建了首个英语—米佐语法律判决平行数据集，含来自古瓦哈提高等法院与印度最高法院的13,168个句对，由米佐语母语专业译者翻译完整文书、人工对齐句对并经两名独立审校核验。语料分析显示英语借词高度选择性:官方与法律术语几乎一律保留英文，而动作、情境、结果等日常概念多回归米佐语表达，且变音符号标注不一致。在1000句对平衡法律测试集上微调NLLB-200-1.3B取得27.47 BLEU，较基座提升7.16 BLEU，但英文词使用频率仍约为人工译者的三倍。
arxiv.reason: 低资源法律领域机器翻译与语料构建，与后训练/Agent方向无交集

arxiv.title: ToM2Vec: Continuous Theory-of-Mind Tokens for Multi-Agent Coordination
arxiv.abstract: Forming an accurate theory-of-mind (ToM) is key to successful multi-agent collaboration and requires reasoning under uncertainty to capture multiple possible partner states. This is hard to do in the text representation space native to large language model (LLM) agents, which more easily describe a single partner state. To address this challenge, we introduce ToM2Vec, which learns to form abstract theories-of-mind in a rich latent space via a fixed budget of continuous reasoning tokens. During training, supervision for these tokens comes from the partner's actual thoughts, which the ToM tokens are trained to abstract and match. At test-time, ToM tokens are generated by each agent and act as conditioners for that agent's thoughts and actions. Across several environments covering collaborative, competitive, and mixed-motive settings (Overcooked-AI, multiparty negotiation, Decrypto, Hanabi, and Collab Escape/Capture), we evaluate ToM2Vec's ability to support multi-agent interactions and collaboration, finding consistent improvements over the base model and a variety of competitive trained and prompted baselines. We show that latent reasoning is critical, with performance dropping when reasoning is expressed in text. Moreover, we show that ToM2Vec training generalizes to partner model families not seen at train-time, including a proprietary model (GPT-5.4). In our analysis, we provide evidence that the latent tokens encode a ToM, rather than task-specific information: ToM2Vec's tokens improve the agent's ability to directly answer questions about partner beliefs, desires, and next actions.
arxiv.titleZh: ToM2Vec:面向多智能体协作的连续心智理论 token
arxiv.summaryZh: LLM 智能体在文本空间中倾向描述单一伙伴状态，难以在不确定下表征多种可能的伙伴心智状态。方法用固定预算的连续推理 token 在隐空间学习抽象心智理论，训练时以伙伴真实想法为监督让这些 token 去抽象并对齐，测试时由各智能体自行生成并作为自身思考与行动的调制条件。在 Overcooked-AI、多方谈判、Decrypto、Hanabi、Collab Escape/Capture 等协作、竞争与混合动机环境中稳定优于基座模型与多种训练/提示基线;把推理改为文本形式性能即下降，说明隐式推理是关键，且可泛化到训练时未见过的伙伴模型家族(含 GPT-5.4)。分析显示这些 token 确实编码心智理论:能提升智能体直接回答伙伴信念、欲望与下一步行动问题的能力。
arxiv.reason: LLM 多智能体协作中的隐空间心智理论建模，方法新颖但偏博弈环境

arxiv.title: Graph Topology Meets Energy-Driven Pathfinding: Preserving Contextual Consistency in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
arxiv.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) frequently integrates knowledge graphs (KGs) for complex multi-hop question answering. However, their performance is increasingly bottlenecked by the knowledge structuring and reasoning processes. (i) Severe semantic loss: Distilling continuous texts into discrete symbols strips away contextual nuances and narrative coherence. (ii) Pronounced modality mismatch: Fragmented graph structures clash with the continuous texts LLMs are pre-trained on, while rewriting them into natural language introduces generative noise and omits information. To address these limitations, we propose ThreadRAG, a semantic-topology-based RAG framework for context-preserving knowledge structuring and modality-native evidence reasoning. ThreadRAG introduces a Semantic Topology Mapper (STM), which organizes retrieved documents into context-intact Semantic Nodes and constructs a Semantic Topology Graph (STG) through narrative, semantic, and lexical edges. It further incorporates Energy-Driven Pathfinding (EDP), which identifies query-relevant subgraphs via energy diffusion and deterministically linearizes them into coherent textual evidence paths. Experiments on three multi-hop QA benchmarks demonstrate that ThreadRAG consistently outperforms strong baselines. Notably, it achieves a 14.4% EM improvement over text-centric methods on HotpotQA and surpasses the best baseline by 5.8% EM on 2WikiMultihop, while reducing token cost to 23.3% of the strongest baseline.
arxiv.comment: Accepted to Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2026
arxiv.titleZh: 图拓扑遇上能量驱动寻路:在检索增强生成中保持上下文一致性
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对知识图谱增强RAG的语义损失与图结构同LLM文本预训练不匹配问题，提出ThreadRAG:语义拓扑映射器将检索文档组织为上下文完整的语义节点，并以叙事、语义、词汇三类边构建语义拓扑图;能量驱动寻路通过能量扩散定位查询相关子图，再确定性线性化为连贯的文本证据路径。在三个多跳QA基准上稳定优于强基线，HotpotQA上较文本中心方法EM提升14.4%,2WikiMultihop超最强基线5.8%EM，同时token开销降至最强基线的23.3%。
arxiv.reason: RAG与知识图谱结构化结合的扎实工作，结果清晰，但非核心后训练方向

arxiv.title: FrontierCS 2: A Benchmark for Computer Science R&D
arxiv.abstract: Can LLM agents make contributions to frontier computer science R&D? We introduce FrontierCS 2, a benchmark of 48 open-ended tasks. We take a paper and the code its authors released and delete the paper's contribution. The deleted code becomes the human reference that sets the bar. Earlier open-ended benchmarks give each agent a problem statement and grade one program after the run. FrontierCS 2 places the agent inside a research environment. The agent inherits a working repository and may submit a patch at any point. For each patch, a judge returns a development-suite score but keeps the evaluator, the held-out final suite and the reference private, and grades the final submission on that suite against the reference. The tasks span 13 domains, from machine-learning systems and high-performance computing to databases, security and robotics. Beyond these 48 tasks, FrontierCS 2 keeps a private set of more than 100 tasks, to be announced in the future. We evaluate 12 agents. The best one is Claude Opus 5.5, passing 58% of its runs. No run passes on 16 tasks. A higher score is not the same as a pass: most runs that beat the reference on the combined final score still fall short on some metric or workload. On a shared capability scale for agents and tasks, the median task is roughly as difficult as what the strongest agent can handle.
arxiv.titleZh: FrontierCS 2：计算机科学研发基准
arxiv.summaryZh: 评估 LLM agent 能否在前沿计算机科学研发中做出实质贡献。做法是取一篇论文及其作者开源的代码，删去论文贡献对应的部分，把删除后的代码作为人类参考标准；agent 继承一个可运行的仓库，并可在任意时刻提交 patch；judge 只返回开发集分数，而评测器、留出的最终测试集与参考实现均保持私有；最终按该测试集与参考实现的对比结果评分。共 48 个任务，覆盖机器学习系统、高性能计算、数据库、安全、机器人等 13 个领域，另有 100 多个私有任务待公布；评测 12 个 agent，最佳 Claude Opus 5.5 通过 58% 的运行，有 16 个任务没有任何一次运行通过；而且最终综合分超过参考实现的运行，多数仍在个别指标或工作负载上不达标。
arxiv.reason: Agent 科研基准，含留出评测与 patch 工作流，命中 Agent 与评测方向

arxiv.title: Your Benchmark Is an Empirical Measure Over Difficulty
arxiv.abstract: A benchmark is not merely a collection of test questions; it naturally induces an empirical measure over difficulty. In this work, we develop this measure-based view of benchmark evaluation. This perspective allows us to identify and formalize two central failure modes: measure mismatch, where the benchmark difficulty distribution differs from the intended difficulty distribution, and coverage gaps, where uncovered regions along the difficulty axis prevent benchmarks from detecting meaningful localized training progress. We propose two diagnostic metrics that capture these two failure modes and provide rigorous theoretical guarantees. Empirically, we analyze 25 popular benchmarks spanning 7 domains using carefully estimated item difficulties. Our results show that many benchmarks implicitly overweight certain difficulty regions, so their leaderboard conclusions should be interpreted with caution; others leave substantial portions of the difficulty axis uncovered, limiting their ability to monitor the model improvement process. Finally, we turn diagnosis into action by introducing BenchFill, a simple difficulty-targeted item rewriting algorithm that effectively reduces local coverage gaps.
arxiv.titleZh: 你的基准是一个关于难度的经验测度
arxiv.summaryZh: 把基准评测重新表述为难度轴上的一种经验测度，并据此形式化两类失效模式：测度错配，即基准难度分布偏离目标难度分布；覆盖缺口，即难度轴上存在空白区域，导致基准无法觉察模型在局部难度上的真实进步。为此提出两个带理论保证的诊断指标，在 7 个领域 25 个流行基准上用估计出的题目难度实测，发现不少基准隐式偏重某些难度区间，使排行榜结论需要谨慎解读，另一些基准则留下大片未覆盖区间，难以监测模型改进过程。进一步给出 BenchFill：按难度目标改写题目的简单算法，可有效缩小局部覆盖缺口，把诊断转为可操作的修基准手段。
arxiv.reason: 基准评测方法学，诊断指标加理论保证，直击评测可靠性方向

arxiv.title: Task-Preserving Multilingual Instruction Tuning for Open-Ended QA in WMT 2026 MIST
arxiv.abstract: This paper describes our submission to the WMT 2026 Multilingual Instruction Shared Task. We adapt Qwen3-8B with LoRA using organiser-provided data, EuroAlpaca, a multilingual instruction dataset created through task-preserving localisation, and CrossEuroAlpaca, a cross-lingual augmentation that assigns different source and target languages to instructions, contexts and responses. Our system targets open-ended question answering (QA-OEG) in ten shared-task languages represented in the auxiliary data. Under matched decoding, adaptation improves the mean Gemma-4 judge score on target-language QA-OEG by 7.8% relative to the base model. On an additional evaluation using the Aya Evaluation Suite across all shared-task languages, it yields relative gains of 41.5% in macro-averaged ROUGE-L and 2.9% in BERTScore-F1, with larger improvements in target languages. However, these gains are task- and language-specific. Gemma-4 scores improve for QA-OEG and summarisation in the target languages but decline for context-grounded QA there and across all three tasks in the non-target languages.
arxiv.titleZh: 面向 WMT 2026 MIST 开放式问答的任务保持型多语言指令微调
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对 WMT 2026 多语言指令共享任务中的开放式问答（QA-OEG），用 LoRA 对 Qwen3-8B 做多语言指令微调：数据侧构建 EuroAlpaca（通过任务保持式本地化生成的多语言指令集）与 CrossEuroAlpaca（让指令、上下文与回复分别使用不同源语言和目标语言的跨语言增强）。在匹配解码设置下，目标语言 QA-OEG 的 Gemma-4 judge 平均分相对基座提升 7.8%；在全部任务语言上用 Aya Evaluation Suite 评测，宏平均 ROUGE-L 相对提升 41.5%、BERTScore-F1 提升 2.9%，目标语言增益更大。但增益具有任务与语言特异性：目标语言 QA-OEG 与摘要提升，而上下文接地问答及非目标语言的三项任务均下降，说明多语言指令微调存在明显的迁移与负迁移边界。
arxiv.reason: 多语言指令微调属后训练范畴，但为共享任务系统报告，分量有限

arxiv.title: Privacy in Context Is Being Overlooked in the Age of General-Purpose LLMs
arxiv.abstract: As large language models (LLMs) continue to grow in scope and capability, privacy concerns are on the rise. Since users increasingly interact with a single general-purpose system across many distinct contexts, there is a natural tendency to pursue a one-size-fits-all solution to privacy. Unfortunately, this overlooks a crucial insight from decades of privacy research: privacy is inherently contextual. In this paper, we argue that existing work in prompt privacy is drifting towards attempts to design a unified framework, which is highly misleading and can foster a false sense of security. Furthermore, we argue that even future work in this direction needs to wrestle with fundamental tensions across various desirable properties of prompt privacy. Thus, such continued attempts towards a unified framework need to be reconsidered. We recommend three critical paths forward: application-specific deployment of LLMs, context-specific evaluation of privacy frameworks, and better privacy literacy.

arxiv.titleZh: 通用 LLM 时代被忽视的情境化隐私
arxiv.summaryZh: 指出当前 prompt 隐私研究正滑向设计统一框架，而数十年隐私研究早已表明隐私本质上是情境化的：用户在同一通用系统中跨越多种场景交互，一刀切方案会制造虚假安全感。论文进一步论证即便未来统一框架也须直面 prompt 隐私各理想属性间的根本张力，因此应重新审视这条路线。作者建议三条前进路径：按应用场景分别部署 LLM、按情境评估隐私框架、提升隐私素养。该立场文为 LLM 隐私工程与评测提供了方向性警示。
arxiv.reason: LLM 隐私属对齐与安全擦边方向，立场文分量有限

arxiv.title: Unintended Side Effects of Value Training in LLMs
arxiv.abstract: As LLMs are increasingly deployed in value-sensitive contexts, aligning them with human values has emerged as a post-training objective in NLP, aimed at instilling additional values and guiding model behaviour. However, current evaluations remain narrow. Because values are interconnected, it is unclear how fine-tuning for specific values alters unrelated capabilities and behaviours. In this work, we adapt four instruction-tuned LLMs across individual Hofstede's value dimensions and evaluate them on both cross-value transfer and broader behaviours. We find that value-specific training produces unintended side effects on untrained values, risk preferences, social cognition, and safety traits. Consequently, we suggest that value alignment after post-training should incorporate broader behavioral evaluations, and we highlight the need to investigate where additional value training might best fit into the pipeline.
arxiv.titleZh: LLM 中价值训练的非预期副作用
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有价值对齐评估只看目标价值本身，忽略价值之间的关联，因此难以判断针对单一价值的微调会如何改变无关能力与行为。作者在 Hofstede 价值维度上分别微调四个指令微调模型，系统评测跨价值迁移，以及对风险偏好、社会认知与安全特质的连带影响。结果显示，面向特定价值的训练会在未训练价值上产生非预期副作用，并波及上述更广泛的行为维度。据此建议价值对齐后训练纳入更宽的行为评测，并重新审视价值训练在整条流水线中的位置。
arxiv.reason: 对齐与后训练阶段的系统性实证，在四个模型上做跨价值评测

arxiv.title: Preventing Model Extraction in Contextual Linear Optimization
arxiv.abstract: Consider a contextual linear optimization problem, where a predict-then-optimize (PTO) system returns optimal decisions without revealing the cost vectors used in its downstream linear program. Our focus is on how to prevent attackers, who can submit context queries, from extracting the underlying prediction model. Although the cost-to-decision map is many-to-one, observations across contexts can reveal the underlying prediction model. For linear models, we provide sufficient conditions where the attacker can learn the model up to positive scaling by only observing the decision. These conditions motivate an adaptive attack that alternates inverse optimization with boundary sampling, i.e., using context queries leading to decision boundaries of the current attacker model. To prevent extraction, we propose a mechanism that perturbs decisions only when the predicted cost vector is near a decision boundary. We establish a regret bound in terms of the perturbation radius. For the attackers that fit the defended responses as optimal decisions under the evaluation distribution, we also prove a lower bound on expected extraction error. Experiments on synthetic instances and real data quantify the security-performance trade-off of the defense mechanism and illustrate that our defense can increase the extraction error.
arxiv.titleZh: 防止上下文线性优化中的模型抽取
arxiv.summaryZh: 研究预测-再优化（PTO）系统的模型窃取问题：系统只返回下游线性规划的最优决策而不暴露成本向量，攻击者仍可借助跨上下文的决策观测反推预测模型。针对线性模型，给出攻击者仅凭决策即可恢复到正比例缩放的模型的充分条件，并据此设计交替进行逆优化与边界采样的自适应攻击。防御侧仅当预测成本向量接近决策边界时扰动决策，在扰动半径上给出 regret 界，并对拟合防御输出的攻击者证明期望抽取误差下界；合成与真实数据实验量化了安全性与性能的权衡并显示抽取误差确实上升。
arxiv.reason: PTO 模型窃取与防御，属 ML 安全，与 LLM 主线无交集

arxiv.title: Benchmarking Large Language Models for Detecting Satirical Code-Mixed Sentences
arxiv.abstract: Code-switching is a natural linguistic phenomenon, yet its impact on high-level reasoning tasks remains largely unexplored in under-resourced languages like Romanian. Natural language processing tasks, such as satire detection, rely heavily on nuanced cultural and syntactic cues that large language models struggle to capture. In this paper, we investigate four methods (i.e., random replacement, phrase translation, dependency parsing, and large language models) for generating synthetic code-mixed Romanian sentences with English, German, French, and Italian. We start with an existing dataset for satire detection, compiled from Romanian news articles and annotated at the sentence level by humans, and augment it with over 600k samples, namely CS-SeLeRoSa. We provide an in-depth analysis of the dataset generation process. Then, we evaluate several multilingual large language models across zero-shot, chain-of-thought, and fine-tuning regimes on both the synthetic corpus and a human-adjudicated gold benchmark, namely CS-SeLeRoSa-Gold. While older open models suffer substantial degradation (dropping to 37%-55% macro-F1), newer models like Gemma 4 31B achieve 68.1% zero-shot, rivaling frontier models like GPT-5 mini (69.5%). Furthermore, fine-tuning significantly reduces formatting errors and improves the results, increasing Gemma 4 31B to 77.5% on CS-SeLeRoSa and 72.6% on the gold standard, outperforming frontier zero-shot baselines.
arxiv.titleZh: 评测大语言模型检测讽刺性语码混合句子的能力
arxiv.summaryZh: 语码混合是常见语言现象，但其对讽刺检测这类依赖文化与句法线索的高层推理任务的影响，在罗马尼亚语等低资源语言中尚无系统考察。工作用随机替换、短语翻译、依存句法分析与 LLM 四种方法生成罗马尼亚语—英/德/法/意混合句，在人工标注的讽刺检测数据上扩增出超 60 万样本的 CS-SeLeRoSa，并构建人工裁决的金标准 CS-SeLeRoSa-Gold。随后在零样本、思维链与微调三种设定下评测多个多语言大模型：较老开源模型宏 F1 跌至 37%–55%，Gemma 4 31B 零样本达 68.1%，接近 GPT-5 mini 的 69.5%；微调显著减少格式错误，将 Gemma 4 31B 提升到 77.5%（CS-SeLeRoSa）与 72.6%（金标准），超过前沿模型零样本基线。
arxiv.reason: 多语言语码混合讽刺检测 benchmark，评测方向擦边、选题偏窄

arxiv.title: A Sharp Dynamic Haussler Lemma
arxiv.abstract: Haussler's covering lemma (JCTA 1995) gives the sharp $(C/δ)^d$ metric-entropy bound for binary VC classes under normalized $\ell_1$ distance. We prove a sharp global dynamic analogue for bounded real-valued classes in normalized $\ell_p$, for every $1\le p<\infty$. Writing $d=\operatorname{sfat}_{\varepsilon/32}(\mathcal F)$, we obtain a global dynamic cover of size at most $(C/\varepsilon^p)^d$ for every horizon and $0<\varepsilon<1/2$. Here a single family of deterministic causal experts, fixed independently of the instance sequence, covers every target on every sequence. For $0<\varepsilon<1/4$, a matching worst-case lower bound $(c/\varepsilon)^{pd}$ holds already for binary classes on one fixed sequence, even with real-valued experts. The constants are universal, independent of $p$. For $p=2$, this resolves the horizon-independent sequential $\ell_2$ covering problem of Rakhlin, Sridharan, and Tewari (PTRF 2015) in a stronger global form. For $p=1$, it gives the sharp $(C/δ)^{\operatorname{Ldim}(\mathcal H)}$ global dynamic covering bound for binary classes, resolving questions of Alon, Ben-Eliezer, Dagan, Moran, Naor, and Yogev (STOC 2021) and Malliaris and Moran (Trans. AMS 2024). Our proof combines rank-decreasing correction schedules and accurate sampled prefixes with exact continuations after target identification. Shared-parent routing distributes these continuations among eligible prefixes, eliminating the logarithmic overhead.
arxiv.titleZh: 一个紧的动态 Haussler 引理
arxiv.summaryZh: 把二分类 VC 类的 Haussler 覆盖引理推广到有界实值函数类在任意归一化ℓp（1≤p<∞）下的全局动态版本。以sfat_{ε/32}(F)为复杂度参数，构造与实例序列无关的确定性因果专家族，得到规模至多(C/ε^p)^d的覆盖，并证明匹配的最坏情形下界(c/ε)^{pd}。证明结合降秩修正调度、精确采样前缀、目标识别后的精确延续与共享父节点路由来消除对数开销；p=2时解决Rakhlin等人的horizon无关序列ℓ2覆盖问题，p=1时解决Alon等人及Malliaris–Moran的二分类全局动态覆盖问题。
arxiv.reason: 纯学习理论覆盖引理，与LLM后训练/Agent无直接关联

arxiv.title: Investigating the Impact of Learner Errors on Social Bias in Large Language Models
arxiv.abstract: Existing social bias benchmarks evaluate large language models mostly on fluent, well-formed English, reflecting native speaker usage and leaving non-native writers unrepresented. To address this gap, we investigate how grammatical errors by non-native writers affect social bias. We develop a controlled framework that injects common learner errors into prompts and apply it to three bias benchmarks covering stereotype alignment and demographic preference across gender, race, and religion. We find that grammatical errors increase bias, and the effect grows with the error rate. Among the four common error types we consider, preposition errors produce the largest and most consistent increase in stereotype alignment. Our analysis suggests that errors increase bias when they are more likely to interfere with comprehension. Finally, fine-tuning on erroneous texts reduces the bias increase caused by grammatical errors. Our findings show that bias evaluations based exclusively on well-formed prompts may underestimate the bias experienced by users whose English contains grammatical errors.
arxiv.titleZh: 探究学习者语法错误对大型语言模型社会偏见的影响
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有社会偏见基准多以流利规范的英文评测大模型，忽视了非母语写作者的表达方式。该工作构建受控框架，向提示中注入四类常见学习者语法错误，并在覆盖性别、种族、宗教的刻板印象对齐与人群偏好三个偏见基准上评测。结果显示语法错误会放大偏见，且随错误率上升而加剧，其中介词错误带来的刻板印象对齐提升最大、最一致；错误越干扰语义理解，偏见增幅越大；在含错文本上微调可削弱该放大效应。这表明仅用规范提示做偏见评测，会低估语法有误用户实际遭遇的偏见。
arxiv.reason: 偏见评测可靠性研究，属评测方法学，但非核心后训练/Agent 方向
